context: Permanent pasture producing beef cattle, calf (male, weaned) in france. cycle description: annual cycle of the standard cow-calf production system in the charolais basin. this consists of four components: 1) reproduction, output of which = weaned male calves, weaned female calves not used for replacement, cull cows and a breeding bull. 2) rearing female calves from weaning (9 months) to finishing at 33 months. 3) finishing of cull cows, i.e. fattened before sending to the slaughterhouse. 4) pre-fattening of male calves for 2 months after weaning (before being sent to a separate finishing farm). both st and o3 are classified as extensive systems with 7.5 months grazing from april to november. the grazed area consists of 88% permanent versus 12% temporary grassland - this has been used to calculate the relative time spent on permanent versus temporary grassland during those 7.5 months of grazing.
